Project Atlas: status for the week of October 26

The team completed the vendor integration ahead of schedule, and the first end-to-end order flowed through the new system on Thursday. Load testing begins on November 2 and runs for two weeks.

Two risks remain. The warehouse scanners still run the old firmware, and Ms. Delgado expects the upgrade to take until mid-November. The second is the holiday code freeze, which starts on December 11; any slip past that date pushes launch into January.

Budget stands at 94 percent of plan, with no change requests outstanding.
